rationale: v1.80.1 already supported moving physical partitions and materializing their hosted openings on release, but its held live editor did not paint those openings. This fixes that existing preview, while extracting only E1 gesture owners; the remaining editor decomposition is not delivered.

summary.ru: Двери и окна следуют за перегородкой уже во время перетаскивания, без старой копии.
summary.en: Doors and windows follow their partition while dragging, without a stale visible copy.
